Description: Complete Amazon S3 Automation: Bucket Creation, Policies, Lifecycle, Replication, and Static Website Hosting

CloudLabsDeploymentID.Description: CloudLabs Deployment ID - injected automatically by CloudLabs to uniquely identify all resources

CheckAcknowledgement.Description: Required by CloudLabs to acknowledge IAM resource creation via CloudFormation

ProjectName.Description: Project name used in resource tagging

Environment.Description: Environment name used in resource tagging

SourceBucketName.Description: Source S3 bucket name (used for replication and lifecycle)

WebsiteURL.Description: Static website endpoint URL - open this in your browser!

ReplicationRoleARN.Description: IAM Role ARN used for S3 bucket replication

ReplicationTestObjectPath.Description: Path of test object uploaded to source bucket to validate replication
